  "explanation": <one sentence>}

Case: Patient D is a 50-year-old Black woman presenting with severe left posterior thigh pain. Patient D states that she has had discomfort in her left thigh for several weeks, but this progressed into frank pain two days ago. Patient D tried taking ibuprofen and acetaminophen but she had no relief from the pain. On physical examination, you discover that she has diminished sensation in several dermatomes spanning her left leg. You obtain an MRI of the lumbosacral spine and discover a large parasacral mass extending toward her pelvic floor.
